parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: ConsumerStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the consumer. Valid values:

*   true: enabled
*   false: disabled

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The authentication type. Valid values:

*   JWT

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse list-gateway-auth-consumer --gateway-unique-id gw-0fe488252dc44d55a9dd578751930000 --name test --type JWT --consumer-status true --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse ListGatewayAuthConsumer --region cn-hangzhou --GatewayUniqueId 'gw-0fe488252dc44d55a9dd578751930000' --Type JWT --PageNum 1 --PageSize 10 --ConsumerStatus true --AcceptLanguage zh --Name test
